The Maxxus Serenity MX-LS2-01 is a 2-person low EMF FAR infrared sauna built for the buyer who wants a compact footprint, a compact footprint, and a setup that works in almost any indoor space without special wiring. Plug it into a standard 120V/15 AMP outlet on a dedicated breaker and you're ready to go — no electrician, no hardwiring, no contractor.

Inside, the Serenity uses a dual-tech combination of 6 ceramic and carbon FAR infrared heating panels — 1 ceramic and 5 carbon — to generate deep, consistent heat that penetrates into your muscles and joints rather than just warming the air around you. Low EMF output between 5–10 MG measured 2–3 inches from the heating panels means your body receives the full therapeutic benefit of FAR infrared with minimal electromagnetic exposure during sessions. The ideal operating range is 118°F to 132°F, with a maximum of 140°F — temperatures that feel comfortable and breathable while still delivering a meaningful therapeutic response.

The interior chromotherapy color lighting system with Red Light Therapy adds a light-based wellness dimension to every session. Red light therapy is included in the same lighting system, so you get both infrared heat and therapeutic light simultaneously without any additional setup. The interior and exterior LED control panels give you full temperature, timer, and lighting control from inside or outside the cabin, so you can pre-heat before you step in and adjust on the fly once you're seated.

Audio is handled by a Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with 2 built-in dynamic speakers and a pre-amp — no radio included, but your phone or device pairs directly for music, podcasts, or guided meditation during sessions. The cabin is built from natural reforested Canadian Hemlock wood with a clear tempered glass door and two full-length side windows that keep the interior feeling open rather than enclosed. A floor reflexology heater ensures your feet and lower legs receive consistent infrared coverage — a feature that's easy to overlook but meaningfully improves the completeness of each session. The clasp-together panel assembly is designed for two people without tools, and the unit ships in 2 boxes.

The Serenity fits well in a master bedroom, home gym, basement, walk-in closet, or master bath. At 48" × 40" exterior dimensions, it has a smaller footprint than most 2-person models, making it one of the more versatile options in the Maxxus lineup for tighter spaces. It is designed for indoor use only.

Maxxus Saunas is a product line from Golden Designs, Inc., a California-based company dedicated to home infrared sauna wellness. The Maxxus low EMF line is built around verified EMF performance, responsibly sourced Canadian Hemlock wood, and accessible assembly — designed for buyers who want reliable FAR infrared therapy at home without the complexity of commercial-grade installation. The 5-year limited warranty covers wood, structure, heating elements, and electronics.
